body: Hate speech has become increasingly prevalent on social media, raising concerns about its detection, interpretation, and moderation. Persian, a relatively low-resource language, lacks sufficient annotated data and computational resources for fine-grained hate speech analysis. In this study, we introduce a fine-grained, multi-hop benchmark for explainable Persian hate speech analysis, covering content triage, target identification, hate tactic and moral foundation analysis, textual evidence extraction, harmful narrative inference, and severity assessment. By evaluating state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs), we find that performance generally declines as tasks require more fine-grained semantic and inferential reasoning. Proprietary models generally outperform open-weight models, while reasoning-oriented models show no consistent advantage. Incorporating intermediate reasoning steps substantially improves severity prediction compared with one-shot assessment. Our analysis further reveals that Incitement to Violence or Harm is most strongly associated with higher severity, while political-affiliation targets are particularly associated with subversion-based moral framing. Overall, this work provides insights into LLM-based hate speech analysis and supports more accountable moderation of Persian-language social media. The benchmark is publicly available at https://github.com/kalhorghazal/From-Triage-to-Impact.
summaryZh: 本文针对低资源语言波斯语中缺乏细粒度仇恨言论分析数据的问题，引入了一个多跳基准（From Triage to Impact），涵盖内容 triage、目标识别、道德基础分析、有害叙事推理及严重程度评估。通过对前沿大模型的评估发现，随着任务推理复杂度增加，模型表现普遍下降，且闭源模型优于开源模型。研究表明，引入中间推理步骤能显著提升严重程度预测的准确性，为改进大模型在内容审核与社会媒体治理中的表现提供了坚实的数据与评估支撑。

glossary.explanationZh: 多跳推理，指模型在解决复杂任务时需要经过多个相连的逻辑步骤或信息检索跳转才能得出结论。
仇恨言论分析，利用自然语言处理技术检测、解释和分级社交媒体中的攻击性与仇恨内容。
低资源语言，指缺乏大规模数字化文本标注数据和计算资源的语种。
内容分诊/分流，在内容审核中指对海量输入信息进行初步筛选和优先级排定的过程。
道德基础分析，基于社会心理学理论评估文本中体现的不同道德维度的计算方法。
有害叙事推理，识别和解析文本背后潜藏的攻击性故事线或有害意识形态结构。
